How difficult is it to start with your solution?
It is suitable for quick piloting with further scaling-up business models. In 3 months our customers are starting to get first value. And typically ROI is 9-12 months

Solution is ready to use & accessible to non-technical users. Comes with out of the box AI-Automation workflows which will be pre-trained to your data and bespoke business needs, as part of 3 months start
Solution is suitable for efficient added value developments by any IT team
How complicated is the integration process for your AI solution?
Our team prioritizes smooth integration, offering full support to ensure a seamless transition with minimal disruption to your operations.
Can we use your solution standalone ? How is our data protected?
Yes, you can use our solution standalone from your existing infrastructure, currently we support Microsoft Azure only.
Your data never leaves the security perimeter of your organization this way.
If you would like to use our solution as SaaS, it’s also possible, your data then will be anonymized. Our SaaS infrastructure is secure and GDPR compliant.
How does Tur.ai keep AI costs under control as we scale?

Tur.ai uses models matched to each task rather than one model for everything. Governed execution limits unnecessary retries. In one banking engagement, annual token spend fell from €1.8M to €300K. This is AI usage spend, not total ownership cost.
What do the results on this page actually measure?

Selected banking results, not a forecast for every deployment: onboarding fell from 16 to 6 days, with staffing needs from 34 to 6 FTE. A separate engagement cut annual token spend from €1.8M to €300K. The 3x figure measures process-delivery speed, not onboarding time. FTE describes required capacity, not confirmed headcount cuts.
In what ways will Tur.ai automate our customer service tasks to improve our agents' focus on more complex issues?

Envision Tur.ai handles common queries such as 'What's the delivery time for this couch?' or 'How do I assemble my new shelf?’. This automation gives your team the bandwidth to address more intricate customer concerns, like customized order requests or design advice. As a result, 70% Agent Activities Automated
How will Tur.ai help us minimize the need for human contact in our service without losing our touch?

Think of Tur.ai as the first line of support, handling standard issues like payment questions or return policies quickly and efficiently.
